title: A direct sampling method for inverse time-dependent electromagnetic source problems: reconstruction of the radiating time and spatial support
summary: This paper investigates inverse source problems for time-dependent electromagnetic waves governed by Maxwell's equations. After applying the Fourier transform with respect to time, the problem leads to a frequency-domain electromagnetic system with a frequency-dependent source term. We propose a novel direct sampling method for reconstructing such radiating time and spatial space of sources from multi-frequency far-field measurements.
